meta.name: opencode
meta.httpFramework: Effect HttpApi (with HttpRouter for raw / WS); Hono in function/enterprise
meta.iac: SST v4 on Cloudflare home; AWS providers (dev|production); Stripe / Honeycomb / PlanetScale
meta.ai: Vercel AI SDK 6 + custom @opencode-ai/llm protocol/provider routing layer

conventions.style: No try/catch when avoidable; no any; prefer Bun APIs; rely on type inference; functional array methods; snake_case Drizzle fields; avoid destructuring; const over let; early returns over else; small helpers below the main export; no Claude attribution in commits/PRs.
conventions.testing: Tests run from package dirs (NOT root); avoid mocks; integration over unit when reasonable.
conventions.typecheck: Run `bun typecheck` from package dir; uses tsgo (@typescript/native-preview).

rootEntryScripts.bun dev:desktop: Electron app shell wrapping the SolidJS app

patterns.name: Effect-based runtime
patterns.summary: Long-running services (server, session, llm, lsp, pty, sync) are Effect programs, composed via Layers, providing services through Context.Service. Each CLI subcommand uses `effectCmd(...)` to thread Effect through yargs.
gotchas: A fresh ConfigProvider is provided per listener so `Config.string(...)` reflects current process.env — see server.ts comment.
Don't smuggle stable services via Effect.provideService inside handlers — use HttpApiBuilder.group layer construction.

patterns.name: Effect HttpApi grouping
patterns.summary: Routes are grouped by domain (config, session, project, tui, sync, file, mcp, pty, permission, question, provider, workspace, control, event, experimental, instance, metadata, query, global, v2). Each group is a `HttpApiBuilder.group(...)` with handlers in `handlers/<group>.ts`.
patterns.rule: Use HttpApiBuilder.group for normal endpoints + SSE; use raw HttpRouter.use only for WS upgrade or catch-all. See `packages/opencode/src/server/routes/instance/httpapi/AGENTS.md`.
patterns.errors: Public JSON errors are explicit Schema.ErrorClass contracts (e.g. ApiNotFoundError). Translate domain errors at handler boundary.

patterns.name: SyncEvent + Bus dual-channel events
patterns.summary: `SyncEvent.define(...)` declares an event with `type, version, aggregate, schema` (optional `busSchema` for backwards compat). `SyncEvent.run(...)` records the event before mutation; projectors apply mutations. Sync events automatically re-publish to `Bus`. `Bus.subscribe(SyncDef, handler)` still works.
patterns.rationale: Enables single-writer event sourcing for session replay/sync across devices without breaking existing Bus subscribers or SDK clients.
doNot: Touch the DB directly inside handlers — go through projectors

patterns.name: Snake_case Drizzle schemas
patterns.summary: Field names use snake_case (e.g. `project_id: text()`) so column names need no string redefinition. Bun-sqlite locally; PlanetScale/Postgres for cloud (console/stats).
patterns.imports: opencode uses #db (Bun) vs #db (Node) via `imports` map in package.json — pick the correct driver at runtime.

patterns.name: Self-export config pattern
patterns.summary: Each `src/config/*` module starts with `export * as ConfigAgent from "./agent"` so consumers see a namespaced surface.

patterns.name: Bun-first with Node compat
patterns.summary: packages/opencode/package.json `imports` re-routes `#db` and `#pty` to Bun or Node variants. Catalog overrides + patchedDependencies ensure consistent native module behavior.
patterns.browserBuild: `bun run --conditions=browser` is used for `bun dev` so the same source can target browser-like environments where node:* shims kick in.

patterns.name: Tool registry with plugin extension
patterns.summary: `packages/opencode/src/tool/registry.ts` exposes built-in tools (Edit, Glob, Grep, Read, Write, Shell, Task, TodoWrite, WebFetch, WebSearch, Plan, Question, RepoClone, RepoOverview, ApplyPatch, LSP, Skill, McpWebsearch). Plugins can contribute additional tools through the loader in `packages/opencode/src/plugin/loader.ts`.

patterns.name: Agents + permissions
patterns.summary: Built-in agents: `build` (default, full access), `plan` (read-only — denies edits, asks for shell), and `general` subagent. Permission evaluation in `permission/evaluate.ts` ties together allow/deny/ask rules per tool/resource.
patterns.subagents: `agent/subagent-permissions.ts` defines tightened permission set for nested subagents.

patterns.name: Agent Communication Protocol
patterns.summary: `packages/opencode/src/acp/` (legacy) and `acp-next/` (newer typed Effect implementation) expose opencode as an ACP server so editors/IDEs can drive sessions. acp-next/agent.ts is the host glue.

patterns.name: External + first-party plugins
patterns.summary: `plugin/loader.ts` installs npm plugins under the user's opencode home; `plugin/install.ts` adds/removes plugins. First-party shims (xai, azure, cloudflare, codex, digitalocean, github-copilot) live alongside the loader so they ship with the binary.

patterns.name: Structured logging via Log
patterns.summary: `@opencode-ai/core/util/log` creates per-service loggers (e.g. `Log.create({ service: "server" })`). Init in CLI middleware honors `--print-logs` and `--log-level`.

patterns.name: Process metadata + lifecycle
patterns.summary: `ensureProcessMetadata("main")` is called at CLI bootstrap so child processes inherit a consistent tag. Unhandled rejections and uncaught exceptions are logged through Log.Default.

dataFlows.name: User prompt → assistant response with tool calls
steps: Surface (TUI / web / desktop / SDK) calls POST /session/.../prompt on the server.
Server handler (server/routes/instance/httpapi/handlers/session.ts) yields the Session service.
Session.prompt builds the message tree, resolves model/provider via packages/llm Provider lookup, and calls the route client.
@opencode-ai/llm route/executor.ts encodes the request with the protocol matching the provider (anthropic-messages / openai-chat / gemini / bedrock-converse / openai-responses) and streams.
Streamed tool calls are mediated by llm/tool-runtime.ts which invokes the opencode ToolRegistry. Each tool runs via Effect (Permission check → execute → output).
Tool output is fed back through the protocol; assistant continues until stop condition.
Throughout, SyncEvent.run records session/message/part mutations BEFORE the DB write; projectors apply them, then Bus re-publishes for live subscribers (UI streams over WS / SSE).
Surface receives bus events through the SDK subscribe API and updates the UI.

dataFlows.name: Session replay / cross-device sync
steps: All mutating events are sync events with sequence IDs.
A secondary device requests events with `seq > last_seen` via the sync HTTP group.
Replaying the events on the secondary device reconstructs identical session state.
Single-writer assumption avoids distributed clocks (see sync/README.md).

dataFlows.name: CLI startup (opencode default = TUI)
steps: packages/opencode/src/index.ts: yargs middleware → Log.init, ensureProcessMetadata, JsonMigration, Database init.
If no subcommand → boots the TUI (cli/cmd/tui/app.tsx + run/runtime.* for direct mode).
Each subcommand uses effectCmd to wrap the handler in an Effect program with the right layer (instance ON/OFF).

dataFlows.name: Desktop (Electron) startup
steps: packages/desktop/src/main/index.ts loads the Electron main process: store, updater, IPC, sidecar.
Sidecar spawns an opencode server (or attaches to one) and the renderer loads @opencode-ai/app via electron-vite.
App talks to the local server using @opencode-ai/sdk.

dataFlows.name: Stats pipeline
steps: OpenCode clients emit telemetry → AWS Firehose.
packages/stats/server (Effect on bun) ingests and writes to S3 / Athena.
packages/stats/core queries Athena + PlanetScale via Drizzle.
packages/stats/app renders the dashboard.

local.migration: packages/opencode/src/storage/json-migration.ts converts old JSON state into SQLite at first launch.

concepts.instance: An opencode 'instance' = a project directory. Server routes carry an x-opencode-directory header; layers/handlers receive an InstanceContext/InstanceRef per request.
concepts.session: A session is a conversation rooted at a project. It owns messages (parts), todos, snapshots, and a permission state. Identified by a SessionID (Slug-based).
concepts.agent: An agent is a configurable persona (system prompt + permission profile + model). Built-in: build, plan, general subagent. User can define custom agents under .opencode/agents (see opencode docs).
concepts.tool: A tool is `(name, schema, prompt.txt, execute)`. Tools run inside an Effect with HttpClient + ChildProcessSpawner + Permission service in context.
concepts.permission: Permission is a layered policy evaluated by `permission/evaluate.ts`. Tools call Permission.check before performing side-effects; the host UI shows the user `ask` prompts.
concepts.subagent: A spawned sub-conversation (Task tool) that inherits a tightened permission set.
concepts.skill: A reusable prompt fragment discovered from .opencode/skills/. Triggered by the Skill tool or by user invocation.
concepts.command: User-defined slash commands (.opencode/commands/) executed in cli/cmd/run + the TUI command palette.
concepts.snapshot: Filesystem snapshot used for revert support (linked to a session).
concepts.share: Public read-only session shares served by share/* + server group.
concepts.bus: Process-local pub/sub abstraction over Effect. UI / WS / SDK subscribe through this.
concepts.syncEvent: Event-sourced mutation log on top of Bus. ALL session-mutating events go through SyncEvent.run.
concepts.projector: A handler that, given a sync event, applies the DB mutation. Lives in `server/init-projectors.ts` + `session/projectors.ts` + `session/projectors-next.ts`.

startHere: Read packages/opencode/src/index.ts to understand CLI dispatch.
Read packages/opencode/src/server/server.ts + routes/instance/httpapi/AGENTS.md to understand the HTTP shape and routing rules.
Read packages/opencode/src/sync/README.md before touching any session state mutation.
Read AGENTS.md at repo root for style rules (no try/catch unless needed, no any, prefer Bun APIs, conventional commits).

wheretoAdd.newServerRoute: packages/opencode/src/server/routes/instance/httpapi/groups/<group>.ts (schema) + handlers/<group>.ts (Effect handler). Use HttpApiBuilder.group; declare errors as Schema.ErrorClass.
wheretoAdd.newProvider: Prefer a PR to https://github.com/anomalyco/models.dev (zero code). For SDK-level providers, packages/llm/src/providers/<name>.ts + protocol if novel.
wheretoAdd.newSessionMutation: Add a SyncEvent.define in the relevant session/*.ts; write a projector in session/projectors.ts; never write to the DB directly from a handler.
wheretoAdd.newAgent: User-config under .opencode/agents/<name>.md; in-code adjustments in packages/opencode/src/agent/agent.ts.
wheretoAdd.newPlugin: Use @opencode-ai/plugin types; install via `opencode plug add` (see packages/opencode/src/plugin/install.ts).
wheretoAdd.newUiComponent: packages/ui/src/components or @opencode-ai/app/src/components depending on reuse. Storybook story under packages/storybook.

testing.rule: Tests CANNOT run from repo root (a guard exits 1). Run inside the package: `cd packages/opencode && bun test --timeout 30000`.
testing.patterns: Avoid mocks; tests exercise real code paths. The llm package leverages @opencode-ai/http-recorder for deterministic provider tests.

build.binary: packages/opencode/script/build.ts (use --single for a standalone executable). `bun postinstall` runs fix-node-pty.
build.sdk: packages/sdk/js/script/build.ts regenerates the JS SDK (run after API changes).
build.deploy: SST entrypoint sst.config.ts → infra/app.ts (+ lake.ts + stats.ts + console.ts + enterprise.ts + monitoring.ts under appropriate stages).

gotchas: Local `main` branch ref may not exist — diff against `dev` or `origin/dev`.
AI_SDK_LOG_WARNINGS global is set to false in server.ts to keep ai-sdk warnings out of stdout — do not remove without reading the comment.
Effect's default ConfigProvider snapshots process.env once — server.listen installs a fresh ConfigProvider per call (see server.ts ~line 116).
`HttpRouter.provideRequest(...)` should only be used for request-level dependencies — stable services go at layer boundaries.
Drizzle fields use snake_case; do not redefine column names as strings.
Effect helpers should not return `Effect` if they do no effectful work; keep synchronous parsing synchronous.
Run typecheck via `bun typecheck` (uses tsgo), never `tsc` directly.
node-pty native is patched (script/fix-node-pty.ts); rebuilds may be needed after dep changes.

First-party plugin shims live in `packages/opencode/src/plugin/` AND `packages/core/src/plugin/` — don't confuse them (core/plugin has runtime utilities; opencode/plugin has the loader and provider shims).
There are two ACP layers: `acp/` (older) and `acp-next/` (newer Effect-typed). New work goes in acp-next.

commands.headlessServer: bun dev serve (or opencode serve in prod)

agentGuidance.contributing: See CONTRIBUTING.md. Accepted PRs: bug fixes, additional LSPs / formatters, perf improvements, new provider support (mostly models.dev), env-specific quirks, missing standard behavior, docs. UI / core product features require a design review first.

editorIntegration: MCP (`mcp/`) — both server-side and client-side OAuth
